title: Vet Invoice Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=vet:invoice
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(clinic_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many vet invoice events land each day and how many distinct clinic values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest vet invoice records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct clinic values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how much vet invoice activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
